quote.exact: Chet just came back from the Pacific Fleet

annotations.note: A wedding write-up exaggerated Chet's service; he was still in the East.
Time had explained the word to its readers on Nov. 30, 1942, in the issue Tom told John to read (letter of Nov. 28).

quote.exact: $21 as A.S., $195 as Midshipman, & $300 as Ensign

annotations.note: Tom's 1942 service pay by rank: Apprentice Seaman, Midshipman and Ensign. His whole 1942 Navy income of about $666 is roughly $13,000 today.

quote.exact: It will be a few months before I leave the country

annotations.note: In fact it was less than three weeks. Tom was moved to LCI(L)-62 on Feb. 3, 1943, and she sailed for the Pacific the next day.
